from build123d import *

plate_width = 80.0
plate_height = 50.0
plate_thickness = 5.0
central_hole_diameter = 30.0
mount_hole_diameter = 5.0
mount_hole_spacing = 20.0
rib_width = 4.0
rib_height = 30.0
rib_offset = 5.0

solid_body = Box(plate_width, plate_thickness, plate_height)

# Central hole through Y axis
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(central_hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + 10)

# Mount holes (2x2 grid)
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(2):
        x = (i - 0.5) * mount_hole_spacing
        z = (j - 0.5) * mount_hole_spacing
        solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, 0, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + 10)

# Ribs on left and right sides
rib = Box(rib_width, plate_thickness, rib_height)
solid_body = solid_body + Pos(-plate_width/2 - rib_offset, 0, 0) * rib
solid_body = solid_body + Pos(plate_width/2 + rib_offset, 0, 0) * rib

part = solid_body
part.name = "plate_with_ribs_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(inner_diameter/2, length)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, -step1_length/2) * Cylinder(step1_diameter/2, step1_length)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, length/2 - step2_length/2) * Cylinder(step2_diameter/2, step2_length)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(mount_hole_offset, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter/2, length)
